data.revised_prompt:
Create exactly one clean HD 2D game character attack sprite sheet for Romi, the nautilus player avatar, using the provided nautilus character images as visual reference for identity, palette, silhouette, material language, and art style. Use the provided layout guide only to understand an invisible 2 rows x 2 columns layout with equal cell spacing, centering, and safe padding; do not reproduce any guide elements.

Canvas: 768x768 overall, exactly 4 equal cells arranged 2 rows x 2 columns. Background must be 100% solid flat magenta #FF00FF across the entire sheet, including all spacing between cells. No visible grid lines, no borders, no boxes, no safe-area rectangles, no center marks, no labels, no text, no numbers, no arrows, no UI, no watermark.

Character identity: Romi is a cute fantasy nautilus avatar with a curled blue-violet spiral shell, glossy segmented shell rings, cyan and turquoise luminous frilled fins, small soft tentacles, bright aquatic highlights, rounded friendly shape, polished project-native clean HD game sprite rendering. Keep top-down / three-quarter avatar viewpoint. Do not redesign into another sea creature. No humanoid limbs, no weapons, no cards, no UI, no text.

General frame rules: Romi centered in each cell, same body scale and similar bounding box, generous magenta margin on every side. Nothing crosses or touches a cell edge. Body-only compact “spiral shell rush” attack: Romi uses her own shell spiral and water pressure, not a weapon. Water glow, bubbles, or shell-energy must be tightly attached to the body and inside the same silhouette area. No detached slash arc, no projectile, no impact burst, no wide trail, no dust cloud.

Frame content by cell:
Top-left frame 1: wind-up. Romi tucks tentacles inward, shell tilts slightly back, cyan fins curl close, a small tight spiral glow begins on the shell center.
Top-right frame 2: charge. Romi compresses into a tighter rounded shell posture, fins sweep backward, shell spiral becomes brighter with tiny attached bubbles.
Bottom-left frame 3: strike. Romi lunges forward in a short spiral-shell ram while staying inside the central safe area, shell center brightest, compact attached aqua swirl wraps close around the shell.
Bottom-right frame 4: recovery. Romi opens back to the familiar relaxed silhouette, fins unfurl, spiral glow fades into a few small attached bubbles.

Style: clean HD 2D game sprite, crisp readable silhouette, glossy underwater fantasy lighting, high contrast blue/cyan/violet palette matching reference, cute energetic expression and feel, not harsh, not pixel art. Same character identity in all four frames.
